capabilities: standardize file and folder names on create and rename events
apply custom regex replacement rules to names
update internal links when renaming notes and folders
blacklist folders, files, and extensions from renaming
run a manual sweep to standardize the entire vault
extras: Starts disabled by default and blacklists the vault configuration folder for safety; no marketplace installation documented—installation requires building from source with npm.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to enforce consistent naming conventions across files and folders in a vault.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the Obsidian Sample Plugin.

summary: File renamer that standardizes vault file and folder names to GitHub style (lowercase, no accents, only -, ., _) while updating links.
